intro: Bengor can barely speak, but he manages to tell what became of the orders. The dispatch commander gave them, and on the way to the Blasted Lands the group was ambushed by many murlocs. One of them, named Swamp Talker, took the orders from his hands. They must be recovered and brought to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Orders were given by the dispatch commander. We took... Took orders. On way to Blasted Lands, ambushed.
Murlocs... Many murlocs... One named Swamp Talker. Took orders from my hands as spear thrust into my skull. East... Cave....

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is worse than I imagined. Nineteen of my men could have been spared from the agony which they faced. If only I had not acted so irrationally.
You must help them, friend! I am powerless to act.
